first_page: Conversation page /ask/ for people who want to keep talking to Verse. First: a thread where each turn can be a plain answer or a live card (the same skills as the stage), follow-ups carry the last answer as context to the answer engine, the thread kept on the device and shareable as a link, and a visible "what I remember" list the visitor can edit. Will not build: paid models, connectors to private accounts, voice mode or file reading by a model.
